parsed.internal_thinking: Bob is offering 3 Wheat for 1 Wood. Currently, I have 1 Wood, 1 Brick, 1 Sheep, 1 Wheat, and 1 Ore. My immediate goal is to build a settlement at Node 7 (the Brick Port) on my next turn. I already have the necessary resources (1W, 1B, 1S, 1Wh) to do this. Accepting this trade would give me a massive surplus of Wheat (totaling 4) but would cost me the 1 Wood I need for my settlement. While 3:1 is a generous ratio, the Wood is more valuable to me right now for expansion. Bob is also a known schemer; giving him the Wood might help him build toward the port he's eyeing. I'll stick to my plan and keep the Wood for my settlement at Node 7.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Bob's 3 Wheat for 1 Wood. I still have 1W, 1B, 1S, 1Wh, 1O. Node 7 is open and I have a road connecting to it. I will build my settlement there on my next turn to secure the Brick port.
parsed.say_outloud: That's a tempting offer, Bob, really. But I've got my heart set on a project that needs that wood more than I need a stockpile of wheat. I'll pass.
